name: Acronis API Patterns
description: Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud MCP fundamentals through Conduit: the three `X-Acronis-*` headers (data center URL, API client ID and secret), the partner → customer → unit tenant hierarchy and what an API client can see, the 37-tool surface (34 reads plus 3 writes that are off by default, one of them admin-only in Conduit), the `path` / `query` / `body` argument shape, the different pagination styles per API family, filter operator syntax, nanosecond alert timestamps, response size caps, and the error shape.
